text:
Situation: Atracurium besylate 100 mg/10 mL vials are low at Corvale East (8.3 days, 28 vials) while Corvale General holds 25.5 days (95 vials). The product used at both sites carries NDC 55150021710 and label set ID f7b6a720, which names Eugia Pharma Specialities Limited (FEI 3008461619) as the registered manufacturing plant.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include atracurium besylate as of 2026-10-21. The Eugia plant received a Warning Letter on 2024-08-15. Earlier inspections of the same plant on 2024-02-02 and 2018-12-14 were classified OAI and VAI respectively.

Our position: No national shortage is declared. Supply pressure at Corvale East is local. Corvale General can spare vials without dropping below two weeks of supply.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 20 vials of 100 mg/10 mL, 10 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — needs pharmacy director approval for the transfer request.
2. Evaluate purchase from Hospira, Inc. — not on FDA's shortage list today; label names no plant we could place — needs buyer approval.
3. Evaluate purchase from Meitheal Pharmaceuticals Inc. — not on FDA's shortage list today; label names no plant we could place — needs buyer approval.

Not recommended: No additional actions at this time.
